model.cohort_note: Single-center, angiography-referred patients. Predictions are conditional on that referral population.

catalog.label: Age
catalog.glossary: Patient age at time of evaluation

catalog.label: BMI
catalog.glossary: Body mass index, weight divided by height squared

catalog.label: FH
catalog.glossary: Family history of coronary artery disease

catalog.label: Airway disease
catalog.glossary: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or asthma

catalog.label: Typical Chest Pain
catalog.glossary: Substernal chest pain provoked by exertion, relieved by rest or nitroglycerin

catalog.label: Function Class
catalog.glossary: New York Heart Association functional class

catalog.label: Atypical
catalog.glossary: Chest pain with some but not all typical angina features

catalog.label: Nonanginal
catalog.glossary: Chest pain unlikely to be cardiac in origin

catalog.label: Exertional CP
catalog.glossary: Chest pain occurring during physical exertion

catalog.label: LowTH Ang
catalog.glossary: Low threshold angina, pain at minimal exertion

catalog.label: Poor R Progression
catalog.glossary: Poor R wave progression on ECG

catalog.label: EF-TTE
catalog.glossary: Left ventricular ejection fraction by transthoracic echocardiography

catalog.label: Region RWMA
catalog.glossary: Regional wall motion abnormality score (0 = none)

disclaimer: Decision support and educational use only. Predictions come from a statistical model trained on 303 angiography-referred patients from a single center. This is not a medical device, has not been validated for clinical use, and does not replace coronary imaging, angiography or a clinician's judgment.
